models.name: sglang
models.description: SGLang is a high-performance serving framework for large language models and multimodal models.

models.name: Speech
models.description: A scalable generative AI framework built for researchers and developers working on Large Language Models, Multimodal, and Speech AI (Automatic Speech Recognition and Text-to-Speech)

models.name: inspect_ai
models.description: Inspect: A framework for large language model evaluations

models.name: ChatGPT_on_CTF
models.description: We want to see whether ChatGPT or other AI-LLM (Microsoft New_Bing or Google Bard) are able to help the user to go to some test environment to run cmds to solve the CTF problems (Whether the AI large language models can understand the challenge question and capture the question flags)

models.name: NewAdversarialAttackPaper
models.description: A list of recent adversarial attack and defense papers (including those on large language models)

models.name: DeepSparkInference
models.description: DeepSparkInference has selected 216 inference models of both small and large sizes. The small models cover fields such as computer vision, natural language processing, and speech recognition; the LLMs involve various frameworks including vLLM, TGI and LMDeploy. This repository is the mirror of Gitee.

models.name: Fake-news-detection
models.description: This project is a machine learning model that detects whether a news article is real or fake based on its content. It uses Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques to process the text and classify the news using a Logistic Regression classifier.

models.name: Differential-KV
models.description: Differential-KV (DKV) is a sparse KV-cache inference runtime designed for high-efficiency, memory-bounded long-context Large Language Model (LLM) inference across Apple Silicon (MLX) and CUDA GPUs.

models.name: llm-search-quality-evaluation
models.description: In the era of Large Language Models and vector search, this repository offers tools and processes to answer these three questions: 1) How can I build a dataset with rated queries to measure the quality of my search engine? 2) Is the embedding model the problem? 3) Is my implementation of approximate nearest neighbour search the problem?

models.name: md-bridge
models.description: Self-hosted document converter built on hand-written heuristics, not language models. Ships PDF ↔ Markdown; the architecture welcomes new format pairs as contributions land. Deterministic by design: same input, same output, every run. FastAPI + React, multi-arch Docker, MIT.

models.name: medical-long-context-reasoning
models.description: MLCR (Medical Long Context Reasoning) is an open-source benchmark and evaluation harness for measuring how well large language models reason over long medical documents.

models.name: padwan-llm
models.description: Minimal, provider-agnostic Python client for large language models, built on niquests.

models.name: requivo
models.description: AI discovery engine that turns a vague client request into a structured solution model — then generates delivery-ready artifacts from the same model: discovery brief, PRD, user stories, estimate, acceptance criteria, GitHub/GitLab-importable epic, and release notes. Asks only the questions that matter.

models.name: macqwen-releases
models.description: Low-memory Apple Silicon runtime for local LLM inference, focused on Qwen models and Flash-Next on 16 GB Macs.

models.name: llmtest-perf
models.description: Validate LLM inference performance and catch latency, throughput, and TTFT regressions before release

models.name: auto-crawl-tiktok-post-fb
models.description: Automate TikTok to Facebook posting, schedule Reels, and manage AI replies, inbox, campaigns, and workers in one dashboard

models.name: ai-agent-pulse
models.description: Daily automated tracking of 19 AI agent frameworks. Pulse Score ranks momentum via star velocity, release freshness, commit activity, and community health.

models.name: agentmandate
models.description: What is your AI agent actually allowed to do? Finds limits an agent can slip past by combining individually permitted actions, and flags releases that widen its reach.

models.name: llmjudge
models.description: Self-hosted Large Language Model evaluation platform

models.name: agent-foundry
models.description: Always-on autonomous AI product org. Rich bench of versioned role-cards; a kickoff council staffs the minimum; a lean always-on core (product agent -> engineer -> reviewer -> isolated tester -> release gate); trigger-activated specialists; bounded re-staffing. Built and shipped its first product overnight, unattended.

models.name: llm-youtube-landscape-tracker
models.description: Python + Next.js pipeline for collecting YouTube transcripts, extracting LLM topics, and publishing a live, transcript-grounded dashboard that maps how channels cover LLMs, AI agents, coding assistants, model releases, benchmarks, and related developer workflows.

models.name: ranex
models.description: Evidence-driven governance for AI software agents: deterministic verdicts, isolated workers, signed evidence, kernel-controlled merges. Pre-release, MIT.

models.name: NeXgen-Engine
models.description: One Git repo to configure every AI CLI — AGENTS.md, MCP, skills, memory rendered to each tool's native format, checked for drift and synced fail-closed. Linux & Windows released.

models.name: FewShotTabLLM
models.description: FewShotTabLLM is a few-shot, training-free framework for generating high-quality synthetic tabular data with Large Language Models. The library profiles your real dataset, builds schema-enriched few-shot prompts from representative samples, and uses an LLM to generate new rows that preserve the statistical properties of the original data

models.name: better-rlm
models.description: MCP server exposing Recursive Language Models over oversized contexts — multi-hundred-MB logs, repo dumps, large manifests — without filling the prompt.

models.name: CareerPilot-AI
models.description: Built an AI-driven career preparation assistant that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to analyze job descriptions, identify hiring signals, generate customized study plans, and provide role-specific interview preparation guidance.

models.name: call_me_maybe
models.description: This project introduces function calling in Large Language Models by building a system that translates natural language prompts into structured function calls with typed arguments, valid JSON output, achieving near-perfect reliability with a small 0.5B parameter model, bridging the gap between human language and computer-executable operations.

models.name: llm-distillery
models.description: Knowledge distillation from large language models into specialized semantic filters

models.name: llm_learner_types_prediction_dsaa2026
models.description: This repository is for code and data for the paper, "Large Language Models to Predict and Understand Student Code-writing Processing Behavior" submitted to Educational Data Mining Conference 2026

models.name: football-multimodal-rag-analytics
models.description: An end-to-end Multimodal RAG and Data Engineering pipeline that ingests spatial football data and broadcast video to generate AI-driven tactical analysis using Large Language Models and Vision Transformers.

models.name: ai-incident-investigator
models.description: An experimental AI-powered incident investigation system built to explore how Large Language Models, tool calling, operational evidence, and LLM observability can be combined into an SRE investigation workflow.

models.name: category-not-severity
models.description: Replication materials for "Category, Not Severity: How Large Language Models Misclassify AI Incidents Under the EU AI Act Risk Taxonomy" (SiKDD 2026) - annotation rubric, prompts, expert labels, the classification harness, and 4,198 model classifications.

models.name: epsilon-release
models.description: Purposefully vulnerable AI application for teaching AI application defense (OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 2026)

models.name: ai-assurance-pipeline
models.description: Turns AI evidence into defensible release decisions — LLM triages, deterministic evaluators produce evidence, a policy engine decides.

models.name: wchats
models.description: Multi-tenant platform for deploying customer-service and transactional AI agents in four steps: create, configure, test, deploy. Layout-aware ingestion, hybrid retrieval (pgvector + BM25 + RRF + reranking), a four-node validation chain, Ragas evals and adversarial red-teaming gate every release. Nothing reaches a customer unverified.

models.name: llm-evaluation-harness
models.description: Production LLM evaluation harness: 3-judge LLM-as-a-judge scoring system (faithfulness, precision, recall) using Python, pytest, and DeepEval. Runs 320+ automated evaluations per release as a mandatory go/no-go gate.

models.name: minos
models.description: Harness-free tool-use evaluation for open-weight LLMs: apparatus, model-agnostic call parser, scorers and raw per-case captures. Every number in the paper is re-derivable offline from the released logs.

models.name: IgboAI
models.description: Open research on AI for Igbo language: self-updating literature tracking, corpora, and benchmarks spanning NLP, speech, and language models for a low-resource, tonal language. Tracks new papers and models nightly, building corpora, and benchmarking across NLP, ASR/TTS, and LLMs.

models.name: conformer-training-pipeline
models.description: Fine-tune a pretrained NVIDIA NeMo FastConformer Hybrid (CTC + RNNT) model on a new language — download data, train a tokenizer, fine-tune, evaluate.

models.name: solarbot
models.description: Having archived all whatsapp chats for over 14 years, Solar used all the whatsapp conversations with her ex-lovers to train the language model of this new whatsapp chatbot on her own responding.

models.name: viewforge
models.description: Physically-grounded multi-view dataset generation for vision-language models: single photo in, verified new camera angles + geometry-derived QA pairs out

models.name: Langbridge---LLM-based-language-learning
models.description: LangBridge is an interactive language-learning application that uses **Large Language Models (LLMs)** to help users practice new languages through conversational interactions. The application simulates real-world conversations, allowing learners to practice speaking and improve their communication skills without requiring a native-speaking partner.

models.name: fake-news-detection
models.description: Code accompanying Language Models for Disinformation Detection: To be Large or to be Small?

models.name: SpamLens
models.description: SpamSentry is a machine learning project that classifies SMS messages as spam or legitimate (ham) using natural language processing and text classification techniques. The project covers text preprocessing, feature extraction using Bag-of-Words/TF-IDF, model training, evaluation, and testing on new messages.

models.name: Fake-News-Detection
models.description: A machine learning and natural language processing system for detecting fake news using TF-IDF, classical classifiers, transformer-based models, and ensemble learning.

models.name: bayesian_ml_fake_news
